subsection.title: Solution Strategy
subsection.description: - In one concise sketch, explain the product-level approach and the minimum user-visible capabilities, moments, and information needed to try it. - Include a permission, privacy, safety, limit, or failure rule only when the PoC itself must honor it. - Do not assign Feature IDs or add implementation detail.

subsection.title: Required Acceptance Tests
subsection.description: - List every product behavior the first PoC must demonstrate. - Give each required test a distinct name, starting condition, user action, and observable pass condition. - Preserve confirmed values, permissions, limits, and failure guarantees when they affect whether a test passes. - Use only user-visible or otherwise directly observable results. Do not test implementation functions, internal state, technical layers, or subjective impressions.
subsection.example:
**Required acceptance tests: Practice a difficult expression**
| Required test | Starting condition | User action | Observable pass condition | |---------------|--------------------|-------------|---------------------------| | Expression-specific questions appear | The learner is in the practice workspace | Enters `break the ice` | Practice questions about `break the ice` are visible | | The practice result is saved | Questions for `break the ice` are visible | Answers the questions | The result is visible and `break the ice` is saved | | The saved expression is available later | `break the ice` has been saved | Opens the expression list | `break the ice` appears in the saved list |
